title_candidates: Grok 4.6 targets longer agent work and visual projects
summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.6 for longer multi-step work and stronger visual projects, with immediate access through Grok Build and several partners.

primary_source.title: Introducing Grok 4.6
primary_source.author: SpaceXAI
key_facts: Grok 4.6 focuses on longer agent tasks and stronger interactive or visual work.
The model received extended supplemental training and agentic training across knowledge work, coding, web development, and other domains.
It is available in Grok Build, Cursor, the API, OpenRouter, Vercel, and Cloudflare.
Grok Build and Cursor include twice the normal usage for the first week.
API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.

supporting_sources.title: Models and pricing
key_facts: SpaceXAI's model documentation lists currently available models and pricing.

steps.instruction: Use Grok 4.6 in Grok Build to create a disposable one-page checklist with explicit functional and mobile checks.
Test every control manually, compare the model's self-review with your observations, and remove the disposable project.

risk_flags: The general-user guide uses Grok Build and must not require API keys, package installation, or a private repository.
Provider benchmark claims should be identified as provider-reported and not treated as proof of quality on the reader's task.
